decisions.reason: The finalized system-layout maturity and transition to build and integration are already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; no further change is required.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records that the wiring plan is finalized, and the source does not establish any additional wiring-plan change.
Finalizing the BOM without additional components does not change the required splash-control outcome or its conditional mitigation options.
The milestone and BOM finalization statement does not change the accepted stainless-steel food-contact material requirements.
The source decision does not alter the required structural support or operational stability behavior.
BOM finalization does not itself establish a new electrical-load or cooling requirement and does not change the existing full-load acceptance condition.
The source addresses milestone scope and BOM completeness, not the required matcha texture, foam consistency, or mixing behavior.
The BOM status does not change the approved maximum speed, operating restriction, or supported speed-control modes.
The source does not revise the spout's appearance reference, material, fabrication method, or milestone-local design scope.
Finalizing the component list does not change the required bowl-removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
The statement that purchasing is complete and no additional components are currently needed does not modify the compatibility acceptance condition or provide a new compatibility determination.
The source does not change any controlled-pour, dripping, beverage-preservation, dispensing-path, or flow-quality requirement.
